query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM harnesses h
                JOIN team t ON t.id = $2
                WHERE h.id = $1
                  AND h.deleted_at IS NULL
                  AND h.computer_id IS NULL
                  AND (
                      t.owner_id = h.owner_user_id
                      OR EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM team_user tu
                          WHERE tu.user_id = h.owner_user_id
                            AND tu.team_id = $2
                            AND tu.team_role IN ('owner', 'admin')
                      )
                  )
            ) AS "entitled!"
